title: Election night results page
description: County election-night results website in a 1100 px browser window: URL bar, county header, UNOFFICIAL RESULTS banner, summary bar (precincts reporting, ballots cast, registered voters, turnout) and contest cards with horizontal percentage bars. Variant 'official' is the county's own site; 'spoofed' is a lookalike on a typo-squatted domain (put the lookalike URL and the altered numbers in the fields; the variant adds small visual tells). Contests and candidates are fictional.

jurisdiction.description: Election office as shown in the header. Falls back to brand.aliases.org.

lastUpdated.description: Time stamp of the latest results upload as the site prints it.

url.description: Address in the URL bar. Official: the county domain; spoofed: a lookalike. Use .example domains.

ballotsCast.description: Ballots cast so far, formatted with thousands separators.

registeredVoters.description: Registered voters, formatted with thousands separators.

turnout.description: Voter turnout percent (ballots cast / registered voters).

contests.description: Contest cards, in ballot order (up to 6).

name.description: Contest title as on the ballot.
examples: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) — Harbor County Library

voteFor.description: Number of choices a voter may select.

choices.description: Candidates or Yes/No options, leader first (up to 5).

party.description: Party abbreviation, or blank for nonpartisan contests and issues.

votes.description: Vote total, formatted with thousands separators.

percent.description: Share of the contest's votes, 0 to 100 (drives the bar).

winner.description: Marked as leading / projected winner (check mark).

pageStatus.description: normal shows results; error adds a red error box (results feed unavailable); maintenance adds a grey maintenance notice.

banner.description: Notice text in the banner under the header (default: unofficial results notice).
examples: UNOFFICIAL RESULTS — Results are not certified until the official canvass.
Results posted on election night are unofficial and subject to change during the official canvass. Provisional and late-arriving mail ballots are not included.
